tagline: Restore Your Skin’s Natural Radiance with Kabira Skincare De Tan Pack
intro: Sun exposure, pollution, and harsh weather can leave your skin looking dull, dark, and uneven. The Kabira Skincare De Tan Pack is your essential weekly treatment to effectively combat these issues and reclaim a bright, fresh complexion.

This powerful mask is specially formulated to draw out deep-seated impurities while actively working on surface tan and dark patches. Unlike harsh bleaches, our pack utilizes gentle yet effective natural ingredients to safely detoxify the skin and support the appearance of a more uniform skin tone.

p: Visible Results: Noticeably lighter skin and improved texture after just a few uses.
Deeply Purifying: Cleanses pores and removes the sticky residue left by sunscreens and sweat.
Polishes Skin: Acts as a mild scrub to smooth rough areas, making skin feel soft and supple.

Xantham gum, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Glycolic Acid, HEC, Stearic Acid, Ginol-16, BHT, Glyecrien, Niacinamide, Alpha Arbutin, Kojic Acid di palmitate, Kaolin Powder, Bentonite Clay, Zinc Oxide, Salicylic Acid, IPM, Water, Allantoin, Lactic acid, Azalic Acid, Sodium lauroyl sarcosinate, Butylene Glycol, Vitamin E, Perfume

De-Tan Pack effectively removes sun tan, reduces pigmentation, and revives dull skin. It brightens the complexion, soothes sunburn, and helps restore the skin's natural glow, leaving it smooth and refreshed.
Cleanse your face or affected area with a mild face wash and pat dry.
Apply an even layer of the de-tan pack to the skin, avoiding the eyes and lips.
Leave it on for 10-15 minutes or until it dries completely.
Rinse off with lukewarm water and gently pat dry.
Use 2-3 times a week for best results.

full: KABIRA SKINCARE De Tan Pack (100 gm) - Facial & Body Tan Removal for Instant Brightness | Skin Polishing & Sun Damage Repair Mask for All Skin Types
